security.title: Security
security.sandboxHint: Controls how the agent's Bash and run_command execution is isolated. Uses OS-level sandboxing (macOS Seatbelt / Linux bubblewrap) when available.
security.modeStrict: Blocks outbound network and sensitive paths outside the workspace; requires an OS sandbox backend, otherwise degrades with a warning.
security.modeBalanced: Allows network; confines file writes to the workspace (with an OS backend).
security.modeOff: Sandbox disabled — commands run directly in the host environment (not recommended).

general.title: General
general.workModeDesc: Choose Lucky's response style and tool behavior.
general.programmingDesc: More technical replies and stronger code control.
general.dailyDesc: Concise conversational replies for everyday tasks.
general.permissionsHint: These settings apply to Chat and Code Agent tool approvals.
general.approvalModeDesc: Controls when the agent must ask before running tools.
general.defaultPermissionsDesc: Allow the agent to read files and run read-only operations.
general.autoApproveReadOnlyDesc: Auto-approve read-only tool calls (read_file, list_files, etc.).
general.fullAccessDesc: Allow write, terminal, and other high-risk actions without confirmation.
general.defaultEditorDesc: Choose which editor opens files from Lucky.
general.professionalModeDesc: Enable the Code workspace, editor, and Code Agent entry points. When off, Lucky stays in Chat mode.
general.professionalModeLocked: Enable Professional mode in Settings > General to use Code
general.showInMenuBarDesc: Keep Lucky in the system menu bar for quick window and chat access.
general.bottomPanelDesc: Show bottom panel controls in the app title bar.
general.browserHomepageDesc: Open this page automatically for new browser tabs. Leave blank for a blank tab.
general.defaultTerminalLocationDesc: Choose whether the terminal docks at the bottom or on the right.
general.preventSleepWhileRunningDesc: Use the system power blocker while enabled. Useful during long-running tasks.
general.agentSandboxDesc: Isolate Bash and run_command with OS-level profiles when available. Strict blocks network and sensitive host paths.
general.agentSandboxContainerDesc: Prefer running Bash inside a Docker container when available — isolated filesystem and namespaces for stronger, reproducible isolation; falls back to the local sandbox when unavailable.
general.agentSandboxImageDesc: Docker image used to run commands (default node:20-alpine).
general.runSpeedDesc: Adjust the Agent's maximum execution rounds. Current limit: {steps} steps.
general.openSourceLicenseDesc: View third-party notices for bundled dependencies.
general.sendShortcutDesc: Choose whether Enter sends a prompt or inserts a new line.
general.followupBehaviorDesc: Choose whether input during a run is queued or attached as a follow-up note.
general.codeReviewDesc: Choose whether change review opens inline diffs or the Git review panel by default.
general.importIntelligenceDesc: Reopen settings to refresh the current agent configuration entry point.
general.popupShortcutDesc: When enabled, use Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + Space to quickly open Lucky.
general.defaultNoProjectChatDesc: Prefer Chat view for new chats without forcing a workspace.
general.microphoneDesc: Controls whether dictation entry points may use the system microphone.
general.holdToDictateShortcutDesc: Save the hold shortcut preference; dictation will not start when microphone is off.
general.toggleDictationShortcutDesc: Save the toggle-style dictation shortcut preference.
general.keepDictationVisibleDesc: Keep the dictation entry hint visible in supported input surfaces.
general.dictationDictionaryDesc: One replacement rule per line, applied after speech recognition returns.
general.completionNotificationDesc: Configure desktop reminders when Lucky finishes a task turn.
general.permissionNotificationsDesc: Show reminders when tool permission needs your approval.
general.issueNotificationsDesc: Show reminders when a run fails or needs input to continue.

personalization.memorySectionDesc: Control how Lucky collects and uses memory.
personalization.memoryEnabledDesc: Create memories from chats and carry them into new conversations.
personalization.chroniclePreviewDesc: Enrich memory with workspace context for ongoing work.
personalization.skipToolAssistedDesc: Don't create memories from chats that used MCP or web search.
personalization.memoryAdvancedDesc: The default configuration is tuned for balanced memory behavior; adjust only when you need finer control.
personalization.memoryAutoCaptureDesc: Control how eagerly Lucky creates memories from conversations.
personalization.memoryDefaultScopeDesc: Choose whether new memories default to workspace or global scope.
personalization.memoryIncludeGlobalDesc: Use global preferences and long-term facts inside workspace chats.
personalization.memoryPromptLimitDesc: Maximum relevant memories injected per turn.
personalization.manualMemoryPlaceholder: Manually add a preference, project convention, or long-term fact for Lucky to remember…
personalization.resetConfirm: Delete all agent memories? This can't be undone.

memoryLifecycle.currentHint: This is the current memory used for answers; history is retained.
memoryLifecycle.historicalHint: This memory is archived and remains available for historical context.
memoryLifecycle.deprecatedHint: This memory was superseded by a newer or more accurate memory.

config.title: Configuration
config.description: Configure model providers and Agent runtime parameters.
config.providersDesc: Choose a default model and configure connection details. Enabled providers are available in chat.
config.providerOllamaDesc: Run open-source models locally via Ollama.
config.providerOpenaiDesc: Cloud model services compatible with the OpenAI API.
config.providerLmstudioDesc: Load and run models locally via LM Studio.
config.addProviderDesc: Start from a common vendor, then freely edit the name, endpoint, and models.
config.apiKeyHint: Keys are encrypted and stored locally; they are never uploaded to the cloud.
config.agentDesc: Control Agent runtime limits per conversation.
config.fullPowerDesc: Enable the complete execution loop: planning, tool recovery, MCP/Skills, Git diff review, test summaries, and long-context compression. High-risk writes and commands still follow the permission policy.
config.fullPowerBashPolicyNote: Full-power mode keeps terminal commands confirmable to avoid silent high-risk execution.
config.maxAgentStepsDesc: Maximum tool-call rounds the Agent can run in a single conversation.
config.maxContextTokensDesc: Upper limit on the context window sent to the model.
config.policyDesc: Allow, confirm, or block rules by tool, path, or command. Path escapes are always blocked.
config.policyEmpty: No custom policy yet. Read-only tools can be auto-approved; writes and terminal actions follow the approval mode.
config.policyPatternPlaceholder: Match pattern, e.g. Bash, src/**, pnpm test*
config.skillsDesc: You can also write skills on the Skills page. Load external skill files or directories here, one absolute path per line.
config.enableProviderAlert: Enable at least one model provider.
config.providerAnthropicDesc: Anthropic Messages API with prompt caching and native tool use
config.unpinProjectProvider: Unpin — use the global default provider
